source: Proposal defense presentation (Proposal_defense_narrow.pptx), slides 5 and 7, and Flying DNA presentation (Flying DNA 1.pptx), slides 5 and 6; GIFs converted to silent MP4.

clips.title: A drone in a simulated urban wind field
clips.description: Seen from above, a four-rotor drone hovers over a small park beside a tall stone building. A colored wind field covers the ground: blue bands along the street at left, and yellow, orange, and red patches across the park, with bare trees and street lamps. The drone moves a short distance across the park.
clips.credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 5. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4; the simulator's toolbar and status text are cropped out.
clips.scope: Simulation visualization; the colors show the simulated wind field, not measured wind.

clips.title: A real multirotor drone flying outdoors
clips.description: Filmed from the ground, a multirotor drone flies against a clear blue sky. As it moves across the frame, bare winter trees come into view along the bottom.
clips.credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 5. Embedded video scaled to 1280 by 720; the audio track is removed.
clips.scope: Real outdoor flight shown as context; it does not run the study's policy.

clips.title: Wind prediction across a city block
clips.description: The camera flies over a rendered city block between brick and stone buildings. A colored wind prediction covers the streets and a park: a broad yellow and blue band follows the main street, and red patches spread across the open ground. The view turns and descends toward the park, passing trees and street lamps.
clips.credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 7. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4 at its original size and speed.
clips.scope: Simulation visualization; colors show predicted wind, not measured wind.

clips.title: A drone flying a planned path through a simulated city
clips.description: Seen from above and behind, a small drone flies along a street in a rendered city. A magenta line traces the path behind it. The drone passes brick and stone buildings with lit windows, crosses intersections with yellow crosswalks, and continues toward a square with bare trees. Light streaks and patches cover the darkened streets.
clips.credit: Flying DNA presentation (Flying DNA 1.pptx), slide 5. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4 at its original speed; the simulator's toolbar, status text, and side panel are cropped out.
clips.scope: Simulation visualization of the drone sensing concept; it is not a recorded flight and does not run the study's policy.

clips.title: A drone following a yellow flight path through a simulated city
clips.description: A small four-rotor drone trails a broad yellow path above streets and intersections between multistory buildings. The camera follows it from rear, elevated, and side viewpoints, first overlooking a street and an intersection, then moving close to a building facade.
clips.credit: Flying DNA presentation (Flying DNA 1.pptx), slide 6. The same silent MP4 as the opening simulation: all 628 frames at the original speed.
clips.scope: Simulation from the Flying DNA presentation that illustrates wind-aware navigation; it is not a measured result of the published study.

clips.title: A drone following a green flight path past a tall building
clips.description: A small four-rotor drone trails a bright green path through a rendered city at night. It flies above a wide street with cars and white patches on the road, then rises along the face of a tall office building with lit windows, with intersections and crosswalks below.
clips.credit: Flying DNA presentation (Flying DNA 1.pptx), slide 6. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4 with all 292 frames at the original speed, using the slide's crop to remove black borders.
clips.scope: Simulation from the Flying DNA presentation that illustrates wind-aware navigation; it is not a measured result of the published study.
